text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that enables computers to "see" and understand the world through images and videos. Instead of just capturing a picture, a computer vision system can identify what is in it, a process known as image recognition. For example, it can tell the difference between a cat, a car, or a tree. A more advanced skill is object detection, which not only recognizes objects but also locates them within the image, drawing boxes around them. These technologies have many practical applications. In medicine, they help doctors analyze X-rays. In retail, they track inventory. Perhaps most importantly, they are crucial for self-driving cars, allowing the vehicle to quickly recognize pedestrians, traffic lights, and other cars, so it can navigate safely and make decisions in real time.
